revisionReason: The user rejected an unknown-freshness summary and asked for source-by-source update dates and specific missing updates.
sourceRequest: 아니 내가 데이터 업데이트 현황을 잘 파악할 수 있게 해줘야지. 어떤 데이터 소스가 어디까지 업데이트되었는지 또는 어떤 데이터가 어떻게 데이터 최신화가 안되었는지. 아직 판단 불가 이 상태는 내가 뭐 어떻게 현황파악하라는거야!
outcome: Show actual latest data dates by source, distinguish them from file-upload and inspection times, identify concrete published dates missing from the lake, and provide a full on-demand dataset list in #data-watch.
constraints: Use only published qdata read APIs and stored bounded inspection receipts; do not scan raw lake paths or copy credentials.
Never mistake future event dates, object modification times or dataset-wide maxima for per-instrument completeness.
A reviewed source checkpoint may identify a missing published date, while age-only triage remains explicitly provisional.
Do not start ingestion, alter source data, activate frozen research checks or change unrelated employees.
Preserve concurrent housing and Quant services; API and data-watch worker must run an integrated source revision before claiming on-demand status works.
Do not replay an uncertain Slack write.

acceptance: Record the last data date and file replacement date separately for the live datasets.
Use the correct date axis for SEC, OECD and future-dated corporate actions.
Distinguish confirmed public-source gaps, age-only investigation hints, historical references and unreadable datasets.

deliverables.description: Readable daily and on-demand Slack status
acceptance: Daily message shows KRX, US daily, macro and filing dates and the specific datasets needing attention.
The on-demand list shows all current datasets with last data date and file replacement date in one message.
Failed catalog reads mark retained dates as previous observations.

deliverables.description: Integrated validation and actual Slack delivery
acceptance: Real PostgreSQL and Temporal regression, deployment contract and CI pass.
The production API and data-watch worker use code that preserves concurrent housing and Quant changes.
A new Slack summary and on-demand response are checked against durable delivery receipts, with unresolved real-owner E2E boundaries stated.

nonGoals: Automatically refresh qdata, repair upstream ingest or claim the source failure step without producer receipts
Full per-ticker or per-series coverage audit
stopConditions: Do not claim live application before matching actual Slack and PostgreSQL receipts.
Abort deployment when production baseline or concurrent service revisions change.
